recentItems.description:
Gunfire & Explosions! Chilling Moments Before Mexico's Drug Lord ‘Chapo Isidro’ Was Captured

Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores, better known as ‘Chapo Isidro’, has been arrested following a major operation by Mexican special forces in Guasave. The alleged cartel boss was among eight people detained in the operation. But the gunfight turned deadly, with seven suspects killed and four Mexican army personnel also losing their lives while heading to the area as reinforcements. Meza-Flores was one of the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted Fugitives. The United States had accused him of flooding American streets with fentanyl, cocaine, heroin and other deadly drugs . Washington had also announced a reward of up to five million dollars for information leading to his arrest and conviction.

recentItems.title: Hours After Trump-Xi-Putin Shenzen Saga, US Blocks 3 Chinese Telecom Giants; Beijing Warns...| WATCH
recentItems.description:
Hours After Trump-Xi-Putin Shenzen Saga, US Blocks 3 Chinese Telecom Giants; Beijing Warns...| WATCH 

Handshakes and promises of global harmony in Shenzhen—followed within hours by a hardline telecom blockade in Washington.
China is hitting back hard after the United States moved to bar three of its biggest state-backed telecom giants—China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom—from directly accessing American phone numbers.
Beijing has blasted the decision as “malicious” and discriminatory, urging Washington to immediately revoke the order or face “necessary countermeasures”.
And the timing is raising eyebrows across the globe: this regulatory strike landed on the exact same day US President Donald Trump sat down with Chinese President Xi Jinping in China.
